start.text: The shift is over. I checked every file change tonight, and the one that kept ending in .locked is the one to stop.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. The one thing that saved us is a copy that was kept apart. Let's make sure it always is.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Every defense does two things. [b][color=green]ALWAYS[/color][/b] is what it gives you in every fight. [b][color=red]AGAINST[/color][/b] is what it does to one attack. Some of the new cards give you [b][color=green]Dodge[/color][/b]: point at the word to read it.
B.name: Carla

C.text: So the first upgrade I buy is the one my clues point at.
C.name: Joshua

D.text: Exactly. Use your Security Points, and read what your clues recommended.
D.name: Carla

E.text: Understood. A copy kept apart now means files saved later.
E.name: Joshua
